Batch crawl stream emits both Page and Error events for mixed success/failure URLs

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::batch_crawl_stream;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"max_concurrent\":1}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let urls: Vec<String> = [r#"https://example.com/success1"#, r#"https://example.com/fail"#, r#"https://example.com/success2"#].into_iter().map(str::to_string).collect();
    let stream = batch_crawl_stream(&engine, urls).await.expect("call failed");
    let chunks: Vec<_> = tokio_stream::StreamExt::collect::<Vec<_>>(stream).await
        .into_iter()
        .map(|r| r.expect("stream item failed"))
        .collect();
    println!("{:?}", chunks);
}
```
